name: God Testing Abraham
overview: The narrative of God testing Abraham reveals a profound demonstration of faith and obedience. After God reassures Abram of His protection and promises (Genesis 15:1), Abraham believes God, and this belief is credited to him as righteousness (Genesis 15:6). The ultimate test occurs when God commands Abraham to offer his only son, Isaac, as a sacrifice, and Abraham’s willingness to obey confirms his reverence for God (Genesis 22:1, 12). This story points forward to the greater sacrifice of God’s only Son, Jesus Christ, whose giving secures eternal life for all who believe (John 3:16).
